items.title: Canadian airline hit by Gentlemen ransomware group
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline in September 2026, disrupting operations.

items.title: Berlin Senate network breached by Rhysida ransomware
items.summary: Rhysida ransomware operators compromised the network of Berlin's Senate (city government), one of the higher-profile municipal ransomware incidents of the month.

items.title: AI agents ran an entire ransomware intrusion end-to-end
items.summary: A human operator used frontier AI models to autonomously execute a full ransomware attack on an enterprise network in under 10 hours, with the AI leaving behind an 80-page security audit for the victim.

ransomware.note: Named-victim disclosures were sparse in open sources this run; trackers cite Krybit and Gentlemen as the most active claimed groups in September 2026.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 cascaded into simultaneous disruptions for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok, underscoring shared hyperscaler dependency risk.

outage.note: No additional major hyperscaler incidents surfaced for September so far; trackers note AWS, Azure, and GCP have each had multi-day regional outages earlier in 2026.

items.title: CISA adds Cisco and Citrix auth-bypass flaws to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a maximum-severity Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center auth-bypass (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0) and a Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway auth-bypass (CVE-2026-19490, CVSS 9.3) to its KEV catalog, with a federal patch deadline of September 12, 2026.

items.title: Fortinet flaw weaponized to deploy PivotC2 RAT
items.summary: A Fortinet vulnerability (CVE-2025-25249) is being exploited in a campaign that has infected 178 devices with the PivotC2 Node.js RAT out of roughly 3,000 targeted IP addresses; activity is attributed to a Russian-speaking, financially motivated actor.

items.title: CISA adds seven more exploited flaws to KEV catalog
items.summary: CISA added seven newly exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog this month, citing attackers deploying reverse shells and cryptocurrency miners.

items.title: M3.8 earthquake near Castle Rock, Washington
items.summary: A magnitude 3.8 earthquake struck 20 km east of Castle Rock, Washington on September 5, 2026; no tsunami warning was issued.

items.title: 2026 billion-dollar U.S. disaster count keeps climbing
items.summary: Climate Central's mid-year update tracks a growing tally of billion-dollar U.S. weather and climate disasters in 2026, including winter storms, Hawaii flooding, and a run of central-U.S. severe storms.

physical.note: September-specific single-event disasters (e.g. South Asia and U.S. flash flooding reported in late August/early September) surfaced only in secondary roundups without a clear primary source this run and are omitted pending confirmation.
